summary: Tested Trusted Contacts feature end-to-end: backend endpoints (GET/PUT /api/me/trusted-contacts with all validations), SOS integration (contacts_alerted count, 5-min rate limit returning 0, public_token hidden from admin listing, GET /api/sos/public/{token}), and frontend Profile UI (add/save/remove, 3-contact cap, validation toasts) plus public /sos/{token} page with map, directions, and expired-token state. All 10 backend tests passed; all UI assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: _alert_trusted_contacts uses count_documents on contacts_notified+5min window — correct rate limit behaviour verified.
GET /api/admin/sos correctly projects {_id:0, public_token:0} — verified token not leaked.
sos_public endpoint prefers newer live_location from support share — logic looks correct.
Phone normalization strips non-digit/+ chars then validates with regex r'\+?\d{7,15}' — passes with (555) 123-4567 input, good.
seed_data_creation: Test cleaned up its own data (restored ll_tester to a single Mom contact). SOS alerts for ll_tester were cleared and 2 new alerts created during tests (ll-test-1 scheduled_at refreshed to now).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trusted Contacts feature is working end-to-end. Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_trusted_contacts.py.
